bank.name: Seerat-un-Nabi
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: The life of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH): birth, early life, prophethood, migration and major battles.

questions.prompt: In which year was the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) born?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) was born in 571 CE, the Year of the Elephant, in Makkah.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the mother of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: His mother was Amina bint Wahb; she passed away when he was about six years old.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the father of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: His father Abdullah died before the Prophet's birth.

questions.prompt: After the death of his mother and grandfather, who raised the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: After his grandfather Abdul Muttalib died, his uncle Abu Talib took care of him.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the first wife of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA), a noble Makkan businesswoman, was the first wife of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: At what age did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) receive the first revelation?
questions.explanation: He was 40 years old when he received the first revelation in the Cave of Hira.

questions.prompt: Who was the first man to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Abu Bakr (RA) was the first adult male to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: Who was the first woman to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Khadijah (RA) was the first person to accept Islam, followed by Ali (RA) and Zayd ibn Harithah (RA).

questions.prompt: Who was the first freed slave to accept Islam?
questions.explanation: Zayd ibn Harithah (RA), the adopted son of the Prophet (PBUH), was the first freed slave to embrace Islam.

questions.prompt: In which year did the Hijrah (migration) to Madinah take place?
questions.explanation: The Hijrah to Yathrib (Madinah) took place in 622 CE, which marks the start of the Islamic calendar.

questions.prompt: The Isra and Mi'raj journey is associated with which month of the Islamic calendar?
questions.explanation: The night journey (Isra and Mi'raj) is commemorated on 27 Rajab.

questions.prompt: The Battle of Badr was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Badr was fought in 2 AH (624 CE) in Ramadan; about 313 Muslims faced a much larger Quraysh force.

questions.prompt: In which battle was Hazrat Hamza (RA), the uncle of the Prophet (PBUH), martyred?
questions.explanation: Hamza (RA), titled the 'Lion of Allah', was martyred at the Battle of Uhud in 3 AH.

questions.prompt: The Battle of the Trench (Khandaq) was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: The Battle of the Trench was fought in 5 AH (627 CE); the trench strategy was suggested by Salman al-Farsi (RA).

questions.prompt: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was signed in which year?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was concluded in 6 AH (628 CE) between the Muslims and the Quraysh.

questions.prompt: In which year was Makkah conquered by the Muslims?
questions.explanation: Makkah was conquered peacefully in 8 AH (630 CE).

questions.prompt: The Farewell Hajj (Hajjat-ul-Wida) of the Holy Prophet (PBUH) took place in which year?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) performed his only Hajj in 10 AH (632 CE) and delivered the Farewell Sermon at Arafat.

questions.prompt: In which year and city did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) pass away?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) passed away on 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal 11 AH (632 CE) in Madinah.

questions.prompt: Who was the first Mu'azzin (caller to prayer) of Islam?
questions.explanation: Bilal ibn Rabah (RA) was chosen as the first Mu'azzin of Islam.

questions.prompt: Which was the first mosque built in Islam?
questions.explanation: Masjid Quba, built on the outskirts of Madinah during the Hijrah, is the first mosque of Islam.

questions.prompt: What titles was the Holy Prophet (PBUH) given for his truthfulness and trustworthiness before prophethood?
questions.explanation: The Makkans called him As-Sadiq (the truthful) and Al-Amin (the trustworthy).

questions.prompt: Which tribe did the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) belong to?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) belonged to the Quraysh tribe of Makkah, specifically Banu Hashim.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the Prophet's (PBUH) grandfather?
questions.explanation: His grandfather was Abdul-Muttalib ibn Hashim.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) worked as a shepherd in his youth. Whose flocks did he tend?
options: The flocks of the Makkans for hire
questions.explanation: Like many prophets, he shepherded sheep for the people of Makkah for payment in his youth.

questions.prompt: At the rebuilding of the Kaaba, the Prophet (PBUH) was chosen to place which object?
questions.explanation: The Quraysh chose him to place the Black Stone, and he resolved the dispute by having the tribes hold the cloth together.

questions.prompt: What was the 'Hilf-ul-Fudul'?
options: An alliance for justice and protecting the oppressed
questions.explanation: The Hilf-ul-Fudul was a pre-Islamic pact to aid the oppressed, which the Prophet (PBUH) later praised.

questions.prompt: Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet (PBUH) after Khadijah?
questions.explanation: Zaid bin Harithah, his freed slave and adopted son, was among the very first to accept Islam.

questions.prompt: How long did the Prophet (PBUH) receive revelation in Makkah before the Hijrah?
questions.explanation: The Makkan period of revelation lasted about 13 years (610-622 CE).

questions.prompt: Who was the first martyr of Islam?
questions.explanation: Sumayyah, mother of Ammar bin Yasir, was martyred by Abu Jahl — the first martyr of Islam.

questions.prompt: What did the Quraysh offer the Prophet (PBUH) to abandon his mission?
options: A share of the Kaaba treasury
questions.explanation: The Quraysh offered him wealth, status and marriage alliances, which he refused.

questions.prompt: Which Surah of the Quran is a reply to the Quraysh's offer of compromise?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kafirun (The Disbelievers) is the definitive answer rejecting any compromise in faith.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) visited Taif to invite its people to Islam. What was the outcome?
options: He was rejected and stoned by the people of Taif
questions.explanation: The people of Taif rejected him and had him stoned; the angel offered to destroy them, but he refused and prayed for their guidance.

questions.prompt: Who accepted Islam after hearing the Quran in a famous incident and was once his bitter enemy?
questions.explanation: Umar (RA), initially a fierce opponent, embraced Islam after hearing Surah Taha — strengthening the Muslims of Makkah.

questions.prompt: The 'Year of Sorrow' (Aam-ul-Huzn) refers to which year?
questions.explanation: In 619 CE the Prophet (PBUH) lost both Khadijah and Abu Talib, a year of profound sorrow.

questions.prompt: During the Mi'raj, how many daily prayers were initially prescribed before being reduced to five?
questions.explanation: Fifty prayers were prescribed, then reduced to five at Musa's (AS) advice, with the reward of fifty.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) cousin who slept in his bed during the Hijrah to deceive the Quraysh?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) slept in the Prophet's (PBUH) bed on the night of the Hijrah, allowing him to escape safely.

questions.prompt: Who guided the Prophet (PBUH) and Abu Bakr to Madinah via a secret route?
options: Abdullah bin Uraiqit, a non-Muslim guide
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) hired Abdullah bin Uraiqit, a pagan guide, to lead them on the less-traveled coastal route.

questions.prompt: What event is marked as the start of the Islamic calendar?
questions.explanation: Caliph Umar established the Hijri calendar starting from the Hijrah year 622 CE.

questions.prompt: Which group welcomed the Prophet (PBUH) in Madinah and is known as the 'Ansar'?
options: The Muslims of Madinah (Aws and Khazraj)
questions.explanation: The Ansar (Helpers) were the Muslims of Madinah from the Aws and Khazraj tribes who hosted the Muhajirin.

questions.prompt: The emigrants who left Makkah with the Prophet (PBUH) are called?
questions.explanation: The Muhajirin are the Muslims who migrated from Makkah to Madinah.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) established brotherhood (Mu'akhat) between whom in Madinah?
questions.explanation: He paired each Muhajir with an Ansari brother to build bonds of brotherhood and support.

questions.prompt: Where did the camel of the Prophet (PBUH) stop in Madinah, where Masjid-e-Nabawi was later built?
options: At the land of two orphans (Sahl and Suhail)
questions.explanation: His camel stopped at a date-drying yard owned by orphans Sahl and Suhail; the Prophet (PBUH) bought it for the mosque.

questions.prompt: Who was the Prophet's (PBUH) uncle who protected him in Makkah and died a non-Muslim?
questions.explanation: Abu Talib protected him for decades but passed away before embracing Islam, in 619 CE.

questions.prompt: Which uncle of the Prophet (PBUH) embraced Islam and was martyred at Uhud?
questions.explanation: Hamza (RA), 'Sayyid-ush-Shuhada' (leader of the martyrs), was martyred at Uhud.

questions.prompt: Which son of Abu Lahab's wife was martyred at Badr?
questions.explanation: Utbah bin Abi Lahab was a Muslim who died at Badr, fighting against his own family.

questions.prompt: How many sons did the Prophet (PBUH) have?
questions.explanation: His sons were Qasim, Abdullah (Tayyib/Tahir) and Ibrahim; all died in infancy.

questions.prompt: How many daughters did the Prophet (PBUH) have?
questions.explanation: His daughters were Zainab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah (RA).

questions.prompt: The mother of Prophet Ibrahim (son of the Prophet PBUH) was?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (RA), who died as an infant, was born to Maria al-Qibtiyyah (RA).

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was the daughter of Abu Bakr?
questions.explanation: Aisha bint Abu Bakr (RA) married the Prophet (PBUH) after the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was the daughter of Umar?
questions.explanation: Hafsa bint Umar (RA) was the daughter of Umar ibn al-Khattab.

questions.prompt: Which wife of the Prophet (PBUH) was a Jewish captive from Banu Nadir who embraced Islam?
questions.explanation: Safiyyah (RA), daughter of the Banu Nadir chief, embraced Islam and married the Prophet (PBUH) after Khaybar.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) worked as a trader for which wealthy widow?
questions.explanation: He managed Khadijah's trade before marriage.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) married Khadijah (RA) at what age?
questions.explanation: He married Khadijah at 25.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) first child was:
questions.explanation: Qasim was his first child.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) youngest daughter was:
questions.explanation: Fatimah was the youngest.

questions.prompt: Which of the Prophet's (PBUH) daughters married Uthman (RA)?
questions.explanation: Uthman married Ruqayyah, then Umm Kulthum.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) was known as 'Al-Amin' meaning:
questions.explanation: He earned the title Al-Amin.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) was also known as 'As-Sadiq' meaning:
questions.explanation: He was called As-Sadiq.

questions.prompt: The 'Hilf al-Fudul' was an alliance the Prophet (PBUH) joined to:
questions.explanation: Hilf al-Fudul upheld justice in Makkah.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) participated in the rebuilding of which structure?
questions.explanation: He helped place the Black Stone during the Kaaba's rebuilding.

questions.prompt: The 'Black Stone' (Hajar al-Aswad) was placed by the Prophet (PBUH) using:
options: A cloth lifted by tribal chiefs
questions.explanation: He resolved the dispute by placing the stone on a cloth.

questions.prompt: The 'Seerah' of the Prophet (PBUH) primarily refers to:
questions.explanation: Seerah is the prophetic biography.

questions.prompt: The famous first biography of the Prophet (PBUH) was written by:
questions.explanation: Ibn Ishaq wrote the earliest sirah.

questions.prompt: The 'Seerat-un-Nabi' (in Urdu) was written by:
questions.explanation: Shibli and Nadvi authored this Urdu classic.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) camel during Hijrah was named:
questions.explanation: Qaswa was his mount on the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: The 'Buraq' was the mount used during:
questions.explanation: Buraq carried him on the Isra.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) had how many wives in total?
questions.explanation: He married 11 women in total.

questions.prompt: The Prophet's (PBUH) seal (stamp) bore the words:
questions.explanation: His seal read 'Muhammad, Messenger of Allah'.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) sent letters inviting rulers to Islam during:
questions.explanation: After Hudaibiya, letters went to rulers.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) is buried in which mosque?
questions.explanation: He rests in Masjid Nabawi.

questions.prompt: Who was the wet nurse (foster mother) of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Halimah Sa'diyah of the Banu Sa'd nursed the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: As an infant, the Prophet (PBUH) was sent to be raised among which tribe?
questions.explanation: He was raised in the desert with the Banu Sa'd, as was the Makkan custom.

questions.prompt: The mother of the Prophet (PBUH), Amina, passed away at which place?
questions.explanation: Amina died at Al-Abwa between Makkah and Madinah when he was six.

questions.prompt: The pre-Islamic war in which the young Prophet (PBUH) witnessed the alliance of the Quraysh against Qays is called?
questions.explanation: The Sacrilegious War (Harb al-Fijar) was fought in the youth of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: On his first trading journey with Khadijah's (RA) caravan, the Prophet (PBUH) travelled to?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) led a caravan to Syria (Busrā) before his marriage.

questions.prompt: Who accompanied the Prophet (PBUH) as Khadijah's (RA) servant on the journey to Syria?
questions.explanation: Maysarah, Khadijah's servant, travelled with him and reported his honesty.

questions.prompt: During the Hijrah, the Prophet (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) hid in the Cave of Thawr for how many days?
questions.explanation: The two stayed hidden in the Cave of Thawr for three days.

questions.prompt: Who carried food and water to the Prophet (PBUH) and Abu Bakr (RA) in the Cave of Thawr?
questions.explanation: Asma bint Abi Bakr brought provisions to the cave.

questions.prompt: Which companion was called 'Dhat al-Nitaqayn' (the one with two belts)?
questions.explanation: Asma earned this title for tearing her belt to tie food for the Hijrah.

questions.prompt: What was the name of the sword of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Dhulfiqar was the famous sword of the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: The white mule given to the Prophet (PBUH) as a gift was named?
questions.explanation: Duldul was the white mule presented to the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: The donkey on which the Prophet (PBUH) rode in Madinah was named?
questions.explanation: Ya'fur was the name of the Prophet's (PBUH) donkey.

questions.prompt: The mosque where the Qibla was changed from Jerusalem to the Kaaba is called?
questions.explanation: Masjid al-Qiblatayn in Madinah witnessed the change of direction.

questions.prompt: The verse commanding the change of the Qibla is found in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:144 commands turning towards the Sacred Mosque.

questions.prompt: The Adhan was introduced after the dream of which companion?
questions.explanation: Abdullah ibn Zayd saw the Adhan in a dream, which the Prophet (PBUH) approved.

questions.prompt: The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) performed Umrah how many times in his lifetime?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) performed four Umrahs.

questions.prompt: The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) performed the Hajj how many times?
questions.explanation: He performed only the Farewell Hajj in 10 AH.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) personally took part in how many Ghazwah (battles)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) participated in around 27 Ghazwah.

questions.prompt: In which battle did the Prophet (PBUH) suffer an injury to his face and tooth?
questions.explanation: At Uhud the Prophet (PBUH) was wounded and a tooth was broken.

questions.prompt: Which companion shielded the Prophet (PBUH) with his own body at Uhud and was wounded many times?
questions.explanation: Talha ibn Ubaydillah protected the Prophet (PBUH) at Uhud with his body.

questions.prompt: Who acted as the scribe writing the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: Ali (RA) wrote the text of the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah.

questions.prompt: Who was sent by the Prophet (PBUH) as his envoy to the Quraysh before the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah?
questions.explanation: Uthman (RA) was sent to Makkah to negotiate with the Quraysh.

questions.prompt: The 'Bay'at al-Ridwan' (the pledge of satisfaction) was taken at which place?
questions.explanation: The pledge of Ridwan was taken at Hudaybiyyah under a tree in 6 AH.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) sent a letter inviting which Persian emperor to Islam?
questions.explanation: The letter was sent to Khusrau (Khosrow) II of the Sasanian Empire.

questions.prompt: The Prophet (PBUH) also sent a letter of invitation to which Byzantine emperor?
questions.explanation: Heraclius, the Byzantine emperor, received the Prophet's (PBUH) letter.

questions.prompt: Who was sent to Madinah before the Hijrah to teach the Quran and Islam?
questions.explanation: Mus'ab ibn Umayr was the first missionary sent to Yathrib.

questions.prompt: The two Pledges of Aqabah were made with the delegation from which city?
questions.explanation: The Ansar of Madinah made the two Pledges of Aqabah with the Prophet (PBUH).

questions.prompt: How many people took part in the First Pledge of Aqabah?
questions.explanation: Twelve men took the First Pledge of Aqabah.

questions.prompt: After the conquest of Makkah, the Prophet (PBUH) returned the keys of the Kaaba to whom?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) returned the keys to Uthman ibn Talha of the Banu Shaiba.

questions.prompt: The year in which delegations of Arabs came to Madinah to accept Islam is called?
questions.explanation: 9 AH is known as the Year of Delegations.
